title: Use Seedance 2.5 in reference-to-video mode and specify a single continuous…
content:
Use Seedance 2.5 in reference-to-video mode and specify a single continuous clip with timecoded beats (e.g., 0–6s, 6–12s, etc.) to control story progression.

Assign each reference image a specific role (character, creature, environment) and explicitly list what to inherit and what NOT to inherit (e.g., ignore backdrops, extra figures, labels) to prevent unwanted carryover.

Lock visual style by naming a concrete capture pipeline (e.g., cinematic photorealism, shot on ARRI ALEXA 35) and detailing lighting/material cues (overcast daylight through smoke haze, wet cobbles, warm gas lantern points, soot/brass/oxblood leather).

For any subject without a reference image, define it with precise physical and wardrobe descriptors (height/build, skin, ears, hair, coat/skirt) to keep it consistent.

Write shot-by-shot camera direction (framing + angle + movement) and end-state constraints for each beat to stabilize composition (e.g., low wide across street; end state: beast one stride from her).

Add explicit action constraints tied to timestamps to enforce continuity (e.g., hawk spreads wings only between 6–18s; wings folded after perching; core stays lit entire clip).

Include strict count and identity rules (exactly one hunter, one elf woman, one hawk, one beast in every shot; no other characters; no on-screen text/captions) to avoid extra subjects and overlays.

Specify invariant anatomy and state changes to prevent model drift (beast has exactly six legs and exactly two tentacles; left eye stays shut from 12s onward; clothing never changes).

Maintain screen direction rules (who moves toward camera/from far end) and positional constraints (elf stays on the left, never stands back up) to keep spatial continuity across cuts.

Use restrained performance notes (no scream, no flinch, no shout) to reduce exaggerated motion and facial artifacts.

Add diegetic sound cues in brackets (growl, metal wings, impact) to guide pacing and intensity even if audio isn’t generated.

es.content:
Usa Seedance 2.5 en modo reference-to-video y especifica un único clip continuo con beats marcados por tiempo (por ejemplo, 0–6s, 6–12s, etc.) para controlar la progresión de la historia.

Asigna a cada imagen de referencia un rol específico (personaje, criatura, entorno) y enumera explícitamente qué debe heredarse y qué NO debe heredarse (por ejemplo, ignorar fondos, figuras extra, etiquetas) para evitar transferencias no deseadas.

Bloquea el estilo visual nombrando una pipeline de captura concreta (por ejemplo, cinematic photorealism, shot on ARRI ALEXA 35) y detallando pistas de iluminación/materiales (luz diurna nublada a través de humo, adoquines mojados, puntos cálidos de faroles de gas, hollín/bronce/cuero color oxblood).

Para cualquier sujeto sin imagen de referencia, defínelo con descriptores físicos y de vestuario precisos (altura/complexión, piel, orejas, cabello, abrigo/falda) para mantener la consistencia.

Escribe la dirección de cámara plano por plano (encuadre + ángulo + movimiento) y las restricciones de estado final para cada beat para estabilizar la composición (por ejemplo, low wide across street; estado final: beast one stride from her).

Añade restricciones de acción explícitas vinculadas a timestamps para imponer continuidad (por ejemplo, el halcón abre las alas solo entre 6–18s; alas plegadas después de posarse; el núcleo permanece encendido durante todo el clip).

Incluye reglas estrictas de conteo e identidad (exactamente un hunter, una mujer elfa, un halcón, una bestia en cada plano; ningún otro personaje; sin texto/captions en pantalla) para evitar sujetos y superposiciones extra.

Especifica anatomía invariable y cambios de estado para evitar el drift del modelo (la bestia tiene exactamente seis patas y exactamente dos tentáculos; el ojo izquierdo permanece cerrado a partir de 12s; la ropa nunca cambia).

Mantén reglas de dirección en pantalla (quién se mueve hacia la cámara/desde el extremo lejano) y restricciones posicionales (la elfa permanece a la izquierda, nunca vuelve a ponerse de pie) para conservar la continuidad espacial entre cortes.

Usa notas de interpretación contenidas (no scream, no flinch, no shout) para reducir movimientos exagerados y artefactos faciales.

Añade pistas de sonido diegético entre corchetes (growl, metal wings, impact) para guiar el ritmo y la intensidad aunque no se genere audio.

--- CONTINUACIÓN DEL HILO ---
[Thread 1] [Generation goal] Reference-to-video. A mechanical hawk and a hunter kill a six legged beast that has cornered a woman in a steam era street. Single continuous clip, six consecutive beats.

[Visual style] Cinematic photorealism, shot on ARRI ALEXA 35. Steampunk world with fantasy races. Overcast grey daylight filtered through smoke haze, wet cobbles, small warm gas lantern points, soot, brass and oxblood leather, saturated colour only in flame and the hawk's core.

[Reference roles]
@Image 1 defines Evelyn: her face, short brown hair, brass goggles pushed up on her head, brown leather corset vest, oxblood leather pants, and her brass and blued steel repeating crossbow. Use one woman only. Do not inherit the grey backdrop, the multiple figures, the crossbow study, or the labels.
@Image 2 defines Freddy, a mechanical hawk of blued steel and brass with a bone cream facial disc, orange lens eyes, and a glowing orange core in his copper chest. Use one bird only. Do not inherit the grey backdrop, the spread wing view, the detail panels, or the labels.
@Image 3 defines the beast: a large black six legged feline with two barbed shoulder tentacles, pale green eyes, bolted iron collar, riveted shoulder plates, broken rib harness. Use one beast only. Do not inherit the grey backdrop, the three views, or the labels.
@Image 4 defines the street: soot darkened brick and riveted iron buildings, overhead pipe runs, wet cobbles, gas lanterns, chimney skyline. Do not inherit its people.
The elf woman has no reference file. Tall and slender, pale skin, long pointed ears, dark hair pinned up, high collared coat over a long skirt.
[0 to 6s] Low wide from across the street. A narrow lane, soot brick wall on the left, market stalls on the right, pipe runs overhead. The elf woman is backed flat against the brick, one palm on the wall behind her, the other forearm raised. Her chest rises fast, her eyes stay wide and fixed on the beast. She does not scream. The beast fills the left of frame, head low, shoulders high, six legs braced wide, both tentacles rising over its back. Its outline sits offset from where its paws meet the stone. End state: the beast holds, one stride from her. (low industrial hum) <low growl, ragged breathing>
[6 to 12s] The beast's head drops toward her and its jaws open wide. Freddy enters from the upper right corner of frame, wings wide, rakes the beast's left eye with his talons in one pass, and carries out of frame to the left. The beast rears back, head snapping up and away, the struck eye now shut and streaming. The elf woman slides down the wall to the cobbles. End state: the beast turned away from her, blinded on one side. <metal wings beating, talons scrape iron, roar>
[12 to 18s] Cut to a medium of Freddy in the air against grey sky and overhead pipes, wings beating hard, steam trailing from the funnel behind his shoulder. The camera tilts down to Evelyn walking toward camera, crossbow carried in both hands across her waist. She stops. Freddy drops into frame and perches on her right shoulder, wings folding tight. She does not look at him. End state: the two of them standing still, facing down the street.
[18 to 22s] Low angle medium from cobble height, facing the beast down the street. It plants its front feet, the struck eye still shut, growls once, then charges straight at camera. Water sprays off the wet stone under its paws. End state: the beast at full speed, closing.
[22 to 25s] Extreme close up on Evelyn's face from her right. She brings the crossbow up, cheek settling against the stock, and squints along it, one eye narrowing, jaw set. Orange light from Freddy's core catches the underside of her jaw. Keep it still and restrained, no flinch, no shout. End state: aim held. <breath in, spring tension>

[25 to 30s] Cut to a low wide as the beast leaps, body stretched out and all six legs clear of the ground. The bolt strikes it square in the chest. Its head drops and the leap collapses into a fall. It hits the cobbles still travelling forward and slides. Evelyn steps aside to her left without hurrying. The beast slides past her and crashes into a market stall, bursting the timber. The camera tracks it right to left and settles on the wreckage. End state: the beast still, Evelyn standing, Freddy on her shoulder. <impact, body on stone, timber splintering, then quiet>

[Maintain consistency] Exactly one hunter, one elf woman, one hawk, one beast in every shot. Evelyn holds the crossbow in both hands from her entrance and her clothing never changes. Freddy spreads his wings only between 6 and 18 seconds and keeps them folded after he perches. His chest core stays lit the whole clip. The beast keeps exactly six legs and exactly two tentacles in every shot, and its left eye stays shut from 12 seconds onward. The elf woman stays on the left, unarmed, and never stands back up. Screen direction holds: Evelyn comes from the far end of the street, the beast toward camera. No other characters, no on screen text, no captions.
---

fr.content:
Utilisez Seedance 2.5 en mode reference-to-video et spécifiez un seul clip continu avec des beats horodatés (par ex. 0–6 s, 6–12 s, etc.) pour contrôler la progression de l’histoire.

Attribuez à chaque image de référence un rôle précis (personnage, créature, environnement) et listez explicitement ce qu’il faut hériter et ce qu’il ne faut PAS hériter (par ex. ignorer les arrière-plans, figures supplémentaires, labels) afin d’éviter tout report indésirable.

Verrouillez le style visuel en nommant une pipeline de capture concrète (par ex. cinematic photorealism, shot on ARRI ALEXA 35) et en détaillant les indices de lumière et de matière (overcast daylight through smoke haze, wet cobbles, warm gas lantern points, soot/brass/oxblood leather).

Pour tout sujet sans image de référence, définissez-le avec des descripteurs physiques et vestimentaires précis (taille/corpulence, peau, oreilles, cheveux, manteau/jupe) afin de le garder cohérent.

Rédigez des indications caméra plan par plan (cadrage + angle + mouvement) et des contraintes d’état final pour chaque beat afin de stabiliser la composition (par ex. low wide across street; end state: beast one stride from her).

Ajoutez des contraintes d’action explicites liées aux timestamps pour imposer la continuité (par ex. hawk spreads wings only between 6–18s; wings folded after perching; core stays lit entire clip).

Incluez des règles strictes de nombre et d’identité (exactly one hunter, one elf woman, one hawk, one beast in every shot; no other characters; no on-screen text/captions) pour éviter les sujets et surimpressions supplémentaires.

Précisez une anatomie invariante et des changements d’état pour empêcher la dérive du modèle (beast has exactly six legs and exactly two tentacles; left eye stays shut from 12s onward; clothing never changes).

Maintenez des règles de direction à l’écran (qui se déplace vers la caméra/depuis le fond) et des contraintes de position (elf stays on the left, never stands back up) pour conserver la continuité spatiale entre les coupes.

Utilisez des indications de performance mesurées (no scream, no flinch, no shout) pour réduire les mouvements exagérés et les artefacts faciaux.

Ajoutez des indices sonores diégétiques entre crochets (growl, metal wings, impact) pour guider le rythme et l’intensité, même si l’audio n’est pas généré.

--- CONTINUATION DU FIL ---

[Visual style] Cinematic photorealism, shot on ARRI ALEXA 35. Steampunk world with fantasy races. Overcast grey daylight filtered through smoke haze, wet cobbles, small warm gas lantern points, soot, brass and oxblood leather, saturated colour only in flame and the hawk's core.

[Reference roles]
@Image 1 définit Evelyn : son visage, ses cheveux bruns courts, ses lunettes de protection en laiton relevées sur sa tête, son gilet corset en cuir brun, son pantalon en cuir couleur oxblood, et son arbalète à répétition en laiton et acier bleui. Utilisez une seule femme. N’héritez pas du fond gris, des multiples figures, de l’étude de l’arbalète, ni des labels.
@Image 2 définit Freddy, un faucon mécanique en acier bleui et laiton, avec un disque facial couleur ivoire osseuse, des yeux à lentille orange, et un noyau orange lumineux dans sa poitrine en cuivre. Utilisez un seul oiseau. N’héritez pas du fond gris, de la vue ailes déployées, des panneaux de détails, ni des labels.
@Image 3 définit la bête : un grand félin noir à six pattes avec deux tentacules barbelés aux épaules, des yeux vert pâle, un collier en fer boulonné, des plaques d’épaule rivetées, et un harnais de côtes brisées. Utilisez une seule bête. N’héritez pas du fond gris, des trois vues, ni des labels.
@Image 4 définit la rue : bâtiments en brique noircis par la suie et en fer riveté, réseaux de tuyaux au-dessus, pavés mouillés, lanternes à gaz, silhouette de cheminées. N’héritez pas de ses personnes.
La femme elfe n’a pas de fichier de référence. Grande et mince, peau pâle, longues oreilles pointues, cheveux foncés relevés, manteau à col haut sur une longue jupe.
[0 to 6s] Low wide from across the street. Une ruelle étroite, mur de briques noircies à gauche, étals de marché à droite, réseaux de tuyaux au-dessus. La femme elfe est plaquée contre la brique, une paume sur le mur derrière elle, l’autre avant-bras levé. Sa poitrine se soulève rapidement, ses yeux restent grands ouverts et fixés sur la bête. Elle ne crie pas. La bête occupe la gauche du cadre, tête basse, épaules hautes, six pattes écartées en appui, les deux tentacules se dressant au-dessus de son dos. Son contour est décalé par rapport à l’endroit où ses pattes touchent la pierre. End state: the beast holds, one stride from her. (low industrial hum) <low growl, ragged breathing>
[6 to 12s] La tête de la bête s’abaisse vers elle et ses mâchoires s’ouvrent grand. Freddy entre par le coin supérieur droit du cadre, ailes déployées, lacère l’œil gauche de la bête d’un seul passage de ses serres, puis ressort du cadre vers la gauche. La bête se cabre en arrière, la tête se rejetant vers le haut et à l’écart, l’œil touché désormais fermé et ruisselant. La femme elfe glisse le long du mur jusqu’aux pavés. End state: the beast turned away from her, blinded on one side. <metal wings beating, talons scrape iron, roar>
[12 to 18s] Cut to a medium of Freddy in the air against grey sky and overhead pipes, wings beating hard, steam trailing from the funnel behind his shoulder. La caméra inclina vers le bas pour révéler Evelyn marchant vers la caméra, l’arbalète portée à deux mains devant sa taille. Elle s’arrête. Freddy tombe dans le cadre et se perche sur son épaule droite, ailes repliées serrées. Elle ne le regarde pas. End state: the two of them standing still, facing down the street.
[18 to 22s] Low angle medium from cobble height, facing the beast down the street. Elle plante ses pattes avant, l’œil touché toujours fermé, grogne une fois, puis charge droit vers la caméra. L’eau éclabousse la pierre mouillée sous ses pattes. End state: the beast at full speed, closing.
[22 to 25s] Extreme close up on Evelyn's face from her right. Elle relève l’arbalète, la joue se posant contre la crosse, et plisse les yeux le long de l’arme, un œil se rétrécissant, la mâchoire crispée. La lumière orange du noyau de Freddy accroche le dessous de sa mâchoire. Keep it still and restrained, no flinch, no shout. End state: aim held. <breath in, spring tension>

[25 to 30s] Cut to a low wide as the beast leaps, body stretched out and all six legs clear of the ground. Le carreau la frappe en plein dans la poitrine. Sa tête s’abaisse et le saut s’effondre en chute. Elle heurte les pavés en continuant sa course et glisse. Evelyn fait un pas de côté vers sa gauche sans se presser. La bête glisse devant elle et s’écrase dans un étal de marché, faisant éclater le bois. La caméra la suit de droite à gauche et se pose sur les débris. End state: the beast still, Evelyn standing, Freddy on her shoulder. <impact, body on stone, timber splintering, then quiet>

[Maintain consistency] Exactly one hunter, one elf woman, one hawk, one beast in every shot. Evelyn holds the crossbow in both hands from her entrance and her clothing never changes. Freddy spreads his wings only between 6 and 18 seconds and keeps them folded after he perches. His chest core stays lit the whole clip. The beast keeps exactly six legs and exactly two tentacles in every shot, and its left eye stays shut from 12 seconds onward. The elf woman stays on the left, unarmed, and never stands back up. Screen direction holds: Evelyn comes from the far end of the street, the beast toward camera. No other characters, no on screen text, no captions.

Seedance 2.5 を reference-to-video モードで使用し、時間指定のビート（例: 0–6s、6–12s など）を持つ単一の連続クリップを指定して、物語の進行を制御する。

各参照画像に明確な役割（character、creature、environment）を割り当て、継承すべきものと継承してはいけないものを明示的に列挙する（例: 背景、余分な人物、ラベルは無視）ことで、意図しない引き継ぎを防ぐ。

具体的な capture pipeline（例: cinematic photorealism、shot on ARRI ALEXA 35）を明記し、ライティング／マテリアルの手がかり（smoke haze を通した曇天の昼光、濡れた石畳、暖かなガスランタンの点光、煤、真鍮、oxblood leather）を詳述して、ビジュアルスタイルを固定する。

参照画像のない被写体については、身長／体格、肌、耳、髪、コート／スカートなど、正確な身体的・衣装の記述で定義し、一貫性を保つ。

ショットごとのカメラ指示（フレーミング + 角度 + 動き）と、各ビートの終端状態の制約を記述して構図を安定させる（例: low wide across street; end state: beast one stride from her）。

タイムスタンプに紐づく明示的なアクション制約を追加して連続性を強制する（例: hawk spreads wings only between 6–18s; wings folded after perching; core stays lit entire clip）。

厳密な数と個体識別のルールを含める（exactly one hunter, one elf woman, one hawk, one beast in every shot; no other characters; no on-screen text/captions）ことで、余分な被写体やオーバーレイを避ける。

モデルのドリフトを防ぐため、変わらない解剖学的特徴と状態変化を指定する（beast has exactly six legs and exactly two tentacles; left eye stays shut from 12s onward; clothing never changes）。

画面内の進行方向ルール（誰が camera に向かって動くか／遠端から来るか）と位置制約（elf stays on the left, never stands back up）を維持し、カット間の空間的連続性を保つ。

誇張された動きや顔のアーティファクトを減らすため、抑制された演技指示を使う（no scream, no flinch, no shout）。

音声が生成されない場合でも、テンポと強度を導くために、括弧付きで diegetic sound cues（growl, metal wings, impact）を追加する。

ko.content:
Seedance 2.5를 reference-to-video 모드로 사용하고, 시간 코드가 붙은 비트(예: 0–6초, 6–12초 등)로 이루어진 하나의 연속 클립을 지정해 스토리 진행을 제어하세요.

각 reference image에 특정 역할(캐릭터, 생물, 환경)을 부여하고, 원치 않는 요소가 그대로 이어지지 않도록 무엇을 계승할지와 무엇을 계승하지 말아야 할지를 명시적으로 나열하세요(예: 배경, 추가 인물, 라벨 무시).

구체적인 capture pipeline(예: cinematic photorealism, shot on ARRI ALEXA 35)을 명시하고, 조명/재질 단서(overcast daylight through smoke haze, wet cobbles, warm gas lantern points, soot/brass/oxblood leather)를 자세히 적어 시각 스타일을 고정하세요.

reference image가 없는 대상은 정확한 신체 및 의상 묘사(키/체형, 피부, 귀, 머리카락, 코트/스커트 등)로 정의해 일관성을 유지하세요.

엄격한 수량 및 정체성 규칙(각 샷마다 정확히 한 명의 hunter, 한 명의 elf woman, 한 마리의 hawk, 한 마리의 beast; 다른 캐릭터 없음; 화면 텍스트/캡션 없음)을 지정해 추가 피사체와 오버레이를 방지하세요.

모델 드리프트를 막기 위해 변하지 않는 해부학과 상태 변화 규칙을 명시하세요(beast has exactly six legs and exactly two tentacles; left eye stays shut from 12s onward; clothing never changes).

화면 방향 규칙(누가 카메라 쪽으로/멀리서 움직이는지)과 위치 제약(elf stays on the left, never stands back up)을 유지해 컷 사이의 공간적 연속성을 지키세요.

과장된 움직임과 얼굴 아티팩트를 줄이기 위해 절제된 퍼포먼스 노트(no scream, no flinch, no shout)를 사용하세요.

pt.content:
Use Seedance 2.5 no modo reference-to-video e especifique um único clipe contínuo com beats cronometrados (por exemplo, 0–6s, 6–12s etc.) para controlar a progressão da história.

Atribua a cada imagem de referência um papel específico (personagem, criatura, ambiente) e liste explicitamente o que deve ser herdado e o que NÃO deve ser herdado (por exemplo, ignorar fundos, figuras extras, labels) para evitar carryover indesejado.

Trave o estilo visual nomeando um pipeline de captura concreto (por exemplo, cinematic photorealism, shot on ARRI ALEXA 35) e detalhando pistas de iluminação/material (overcast daylight through smoke haze, wet cobbles, warm gas lantern points, soot/brass/oxblood leather).

Para qualquer sujeito sem imagem de referência, defina-o com descritores físicos e de vestuário precisos (altura/porte, pele, orelhas, cabelo, casaco/saia) para mantê-lo consistente.

Escreva a direção de câmera shot by shot (enquadramento + ângulo + movimento) e restrições de estado final para cada beat para estabilizar a composição (por exemplo, low wide across street; end state: beast one stride from her).

Adicione restrições explícitas de ação vinculadas a timestamps para impor continuidade (por exemplo, hawk spreads wings only between 6–18s; wings folded after perching; core stays lit entire clip).

Inclua regras rígidas de contagem e identidade (exactly one hunter, one elf woman, one hawk, one beast in every shot; no other characters; no on-screen text/captions) para evitar sujeitos extras e overlays.

Especifique anatomia invariável e mudanças de estado para prevenir drift do modelo (beast has exactly six legs and exactly two tentacles; left eye stays shut from 12s onward; clothing never changes).

Mantenha regras de direção de tela (quem se move em direção à câmera/desde o fundo) e restrições posicionais (elf stays on the left, never stands back up) para preservar a continuidade espacial entre cortes.

Use notas de performance contidas (no scream, no flinch, no shout) para reduzir movimentos exagerados e artefatos faciais.

Adicione pistas sonoras diegéticas entre colchetes (growl, metal wings, impact) para orientar ritmo e intensidade mesmo que o áudio não seja gerado.

zh.content:
使用 Seedance 2.5 的 reference-to-video 模式，并指定一个单一连续镜头，配合带时间码的节拍（例如 0–6s、6–12s 等）来控制故事推进。

为每张参考图分配明确角色（角色、生物、环境），并清楚列出要继承什么、不要继承什么（例如忽略背景、额外人物、标签），以防止不想要的内容被带入。

通过指定一个具体的拍摄管线来锁定视觉风格（例如 cinematic photorealism，shot on ARRI ALEXA 35），并细化光线/材质提示（overcast daylight through smoke haze、wet cobbles、warm gas lantern points、soot/brass/oxblood leather）。

对于没有参考图的主体，用精确的外形和服装描述来定义它（身高/体型、肤色、耳朵、头发、外套/裙子），以保持一致性。

逐镜头写出 camera direction（构图 + 角度 + 运动）以及每个节拍的终态约束，以稳定构图（例如 low wide across street；end state: beast one stride from her）。

加入与时间戳绑定的明确动作约束，以强化连续性（例如 hawk spreads wings only between 6–18s；wings folded after perching；core stays lit entire clip）。

加入严格的数量和身份规则（每个镜头中恰好一个 hunter、一个 elf woman、一个 hawk、一个 beast；没有其他角色；没有屏幕文字/字幕），以避免额外主体和叠加层。

指定不变的解剖特征和状态变化，以防模型漂移（beast has exactly six legs and exactly two tentacles；left eye stays shut from 12s onward；clothing never changes）。

保持屏幕方向规则（谁朝镜头移动/谁从远端移动）和位置约束（elf stays on the left, never stands back up），以维持跨镜头的空间连续性。

使用克制的表演备注（no scream, no flinch, no shout）来减少夸张动作和面部伪影。

用方括号加入 diegetic sound cues（growl, metal wings, impact），即使不生成音频，也能引导节奏和强度。
